topic: Blue whale versus African elephant size comparison

scenes.narration: What happens when the heaviest land animal meets the heaviest animal that has ever lived?

visual.prompt: a huge African elephant standing on a savanna with a blue whale silhouette in the sky above, dramatic scene

scenes.narration: A big male African elephant can weigh around six tonnes.

visual.prompt: a large male African elephant walking across dry grassland, low angle, golden light

scenes.narration: A blue whale can weigh well over a hundred tonnes and reach around thirty meters in length, longer than three buses.

visual.prompt: a blue whale gliding in deep blue water seen from the side, sunbeams from above

scenes.narration: That makes a big blue whale roughly fifteen times heavier.

visual.prompt: a diagram-like scene of a giant whale beside a small elephant on a dark background

scenes.narration: On land the elephant rules. Its trunk can lift heavy logs.

visual.prompt: an elephant lifting a heavy log with its trunk in a forest clearing, side view

scenes.narration: But in the ocean the whale has no equal, and its call can travel for many kilometers.

visual.prompt: a blue whale diving into dark water with a faint glow from the surface, wide shot

scenes.narration: Scores: size, elephant 5, whale 10. Strength on land, elephant 9, whale zero, since it cannot leave the water.

visual.prompt: a dark background with two glowing silhouettes, an elephant and a whale, split screen

scenes.narration: Different worlds, different giants. Which one would you call the greater giant?

visual.prompt: an elephant on the shore looking out at a whale surfacing far away at dusk

motion.text: Which one is the greater giant?
